world_facts: Hollowmere is a small river town in the year 1347, in a grim fantasy medieval world. Life is hard, people are frightened and superstitious, and the church, the watch and the tavern are the only order left. There is no real magic, only rumour and faith.
default_town_state: The plague has returned, the harvest has failed, and Lord Maelor has not left his keep in months.
